title.narrative: Timorese Civil Society Action in the Field of Democracy Consolidation and Elections

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the Global Europe Human Rights and Democracy Thematic Programme is to promote and protect human rights and fundamental freedoms, democracy and the rule of law worldwide. The programme on human rights and democracy, built upon the key features of the European Instrument for Democracy and Human Rights (EIDHR), is a major flagship tool of the EU.

The global objective of this direct award is to strengthen democratic institutions and processes in Timor-Leste, including transparent, credible and peaceful elections by supporting civil society actions.

Specific objective(s): To support civil society advocacy and action for the implementation of recommendations 1, 10, 13, 14 and 15 from the 2022 EU election observations report[1], including stronger youth engagement on the democratic processes.

The priority of this direct award is to support those civil society organisations in Timor-Leste strategically engaged with democracy support/elections.

The Call will finance projects, which apply the human rights-based approach (HRBA) methodology. The European Consensus on Development commits the EU and its Member States to implementing a human rights-based approach (HRBA), which integrates norms, standards and principles of international human rights law into the plans, policies and processes of development programmes and projects. It applies to all sectors, all modalities, and each step of the project cycle ¿ identification, formulation, implementation, monitoring and evaluation.

Gender equality constitutes a fundamental human rights principle and a common value of the European Union. Gender mainstreaming remains the primary means to achieve gender equality. Its purpose is to ensure that all policies and programmes maximise their benefits for all and contribute to stop the perpetuation of inequality. The new EU Gender Action Plan for 2021 ¿ 2025 (GAP III) calls on making gender equality a crosscutting priority in EU external action. Whenever possible, GAP III gender-sensitive and sex-disaggregated indicators shall be developed for all target groups under this Call.


[1] European Union Election Observation Mission, Timor-Leste ¿ Final Report. Presidential Elections, 19 March 2022.

comment.narrative: We are not able to disaggregate by age here as there is no choice available.

We are not able to disaggregate by age here as there is no choice available.We decided to report an accumulative target for end of 2025. The reason is that we will slowly reduce our support for legal aid interventions in 2025. As the project tries to implement sustainable structures in the legal aid sector it will reduce its amount of funding in 2025 substantially to test how sustainable the provision of legal aid in Zambia is. Therefore the numbers for 2025 wil be a lot lower then for the rest of the years. Thus we only report on an accumulative target.
